shortDescription: Manage S3 zone settings on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: access_zone
options.description: Specifies the access zone in which the S3 zone settings apply.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: base_domain
options.description: Specifies the base domain name used for the S3 service.

options.name: bucket_directory_create_mode
options.description: Specifies the UNIX mode bits for bucket directory creation. Valid range is 0-511.

options.name: object_acl_policy
options.description: Specifies the object ACL policy for S3.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: root_path
options.description: Specifies the root path for the S3 service.

options.name: use_md5_for_etag
options.description: If C(true), use MD5 for ETag generation.

options.name: validate_content_md5
options.description: If C(true), validate Content-MD5 headers on upload.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
